result.summary: Modular-Monolith architecture with 4 services on None

output.overview: The architecture modernizes a legacy VB6 banking application to a C# modular monolith, ensuring backward compatibility and functionality preservation. The system is Dockerized for local deployment, with a focus on translating VB6 components to C# and replacing ActiveX controls with .NET libraries.

services.name: UI Translation Service
services.responsibility: Translate VB6 forms to C# WinForms or WPF components.

services.name: ActiveX Replacement Service
services.responsibility: Replace ActiveX controls with .NET compatible libraries.

services.name: Data Access Layer
services.responsibility: Implement data access using Entity Framework to replace legacy database interactions.

services.name: Business Logic Service
services.responsibility: Preserve and implement business logic from the legacy system in C#.

data_flow.description: UI components request replacement for ActiveX controls.
UI components interact with the data access layer for data operations.
Data access layer invokes business logic for processing.
Processed data and results are sent back to the UI layer.

latency_optimizations: Use of in-memory caching with Redis
Optimized database queries with Entity Framework
Minimized network calls by consolidating service interactions

trade_offs.rationale: Simplifies deployment and reduces overhead for a local Docker environment.
Sufficient for local deployment and reduces complexity.
Easier integration with existing components and tooling.

legacy_system.current_logic_summary: The legacy system is a VB6 application with multiple forms and ActiveX dependencies, managing customer profiles and transactions.
key_logic_steps: User logs in through the LOGIN form.
User performs transactions through deposit and withdrawal forms.
Data is refreshed using cmdRefresh_Click event.
Business state updates occur through various form interactions.
